Terms.disclaimer: Only the last-updated date still needs to be filled in before publishing (see "[to be completed]" above).

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body:
These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern access to and use of the Kouby carpooling platform (the "Platform") operated in Canada.

The Platform connects:
• drivers offering trips,
• passengers looking to book a seat.

Kouby acts exclusively as a technical intermediary.

sections.heading: 2. Acceptance of these Terms
sections.body:
Using the Platform means fully and unconditionally accepting these Terms.

Users agree to comply with:
• these Terms,
• Canadian federal law,
• applicable provincial law (notably Quebec, Ontario, etc.),
• regulations in force regarding transportation, road safety, and insurance.

sections.heading: 3. Access to the platform
sections.body:
Registering on the Platform is:
• free,
• with no membership fee.

sections.heading: 4. Role of the platform
sections.body:
Kouby:
• connects drivers and passengers,
• facilitates trip bookings,
• collects a booking commission.

Kouby is not a carrier and does not operate any transport service.

sections.heading: 5. Conditions applicable to drivers
sections.body: Drivers are subject to the following conditions.

sections.heading: 5.1 Responsibility and compliance
sections.body:
Drivers are solely responsible for:
• their legal capacity to drive in Canada,
• the validity of their driver's licence,
• their auto insurance,
• their vehicle's compliance.

Kouby disclaims all liability in the event of non-compliance.

sections.heading: 5.2 Mandatory information
sections.body:
Drivers must provide accurate and complete information, including:
• identity,
• driver's licence,
• vehicle information (registration, model, insurance),
• trip details.

Any false statement is strictly prohibited.

sections.heading: 5.3 Driver commitments
sections.body:
Drivers agree to:
• comply with these Terms and with local and national regulations,
• strictly comply with the conditions of their listing,
• not cancel or replace a passenger without valid reason,
• carry out the trip in accordance with the booking.

sections.heading: 5.4 Trip cancellation
sections.body:
If a driver cancels:
• they must offer passengers an alternative solution,
• failing that, they must refund the booking commission.

sections.heading: 5.5 Penalties for fraud
sections.body:
Any false listing or fraudulent behaviour results in:
• full refund of the commission,
• possible damages payable to passengers,
• suspension or deletion of the account.

sections.heading: 6. Conditions applicable to passengers
sections.body:
Passengers agree to:
• comply with these Terms,
• comply with applicable law,
• comply with the specific conditions of the driver's listing.

sections.heading: 6.1 Booking commission
sections.body: Passengers pay a fixed commission of 5 CAD per booking.

sections.heading: 6.2 Refund policy
sections.body:
• The booking commission is non-refundable once the booking is confirmed.
• No refund will be issued except as expressly provided for in these Terms.

sections.heading: 7.1 Kouby's liability
sections.body:
Kouby cannot be held liable for:
• incidents occurring during the trip,
• the behaviour of users,
• a driver's failure to comply with regulations,
• bodily injury or property damage.

sections.heading: 7.2 Users' liability
sections.body:
Each user is solely responsible for their own actions.

The driver bears full responsibility for the transportation itself.

sections.heading: 8. Compliance with Canadian regulations
sections.body:
Users must comply with:
• the highway safety code applicable in their province,
• auto insurance obligations,
• laws governing carpooling (non-profit or cost-sharing).

sections.heading: 9. Personal data
sections.body:
Data collected is used solely in connection with operating the Platform.

Kouby is committed to complying with Canadian data protection law, notably the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA). See our Privacy Policy for further details.

sections.heading: 10. Suspension or termination
sections.body:
Kouby reserves the right to:
• suspend or delete an account,
• deny access to the Platform, in the event of non-compliance with these Terms.

sections.heading: 11. Governing law
sections.body:
These Terms are governed by:
• the laws of Canada,
• and the laws of the user's province of residence (e.g. Quebec).

Any dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the competent courts of that province.

sections.heading: 12. Changes to these Terms
sections.body: Kouby reserves the right to modify these Terms at any time. Users will be informed of any updates.

sections.heading: 13. Final clause
sections.body: Kouby acts exclusively as a platform connecting users. The transport service is provided solely under the driver's responsibility, whether acting as an individual or an independent professional.

Cgv.title: Terms of Sale
Cgv.disclaimer: Kouby charges a 5 CAD booking commission, payable online by card (Stripe) or PayPal after the driver accepts. If you pay the ride fare by card through Kouby, that fare is collected with the commission and paid out to the driver after the trip. Interac and cash fares are settled directly with the driver.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body:
These Terms of Sale govern the payment, booking, and billing terms for the services offered on the Kouby platform.

Kouby provides an intermediation service connecting drivers and passengers for carpooling trips.

sections.heading: 2. Nature of the service
sections.body:
Kouby acts exclusively as:
• a platform connecting users,
• a booking service provider.

Kouby is neither a carrier nor a transport operator.

sections.heading: 3.1 Booking commission
sections.body:
• Each booking made by a passenger is subject to a fixed commission of 5 CAD.
• This commission corresponds to the platform usage fee.

sections.heading: 3.2 Free for drivers
sections.body:
• Drivers pay no fee to publish a listing or offer a trip.
• No subscription or membership fee is required.

sections.heading: 4. Booking process
sections.body:
1. The passenger selects a trip and a payment method the driver accepts (card, Interac, or cash).
2. They confirm their booking through the platform.
3. They pay Kouby online: 5 CAD commission only (Interac/cash), or the ride fare plus 5 CAD (card).
4. The booking is considered firm and final once that payment is confirmed.

sections.heading: 5.1 Payment methods
sections.body:
Payments can be made via:
• credit/debit card,
• any other secure payment method offered on the platform.

sections.heading: 5.2 Security
sections.body: Kouby implements secure payment solutions that comply with current standards.

sections.heading: 6.1 General principle
sections.body:
• The booking commission is non-refundable once the booking is confirmed.
• If the passenger cancels a confirmed card booking, Kouby refunds the ride fare and keeps the 5 CAD commission.

sections.heading: 6.2 Exception — Cancellation by the driver
sections.body:
If the driver cancels the trip:
• the passenger may receive a refund of the amount paid to Kouby (commission, and the ride fare when it was collected by card),
• or an alternative solution offered by the driver.

sections.heading: 7. Driver obligations affecting the sale
sections.body:
Drivers agree to:
• comply with the conditions of their listing,
• carry out the trip in accordance with the booking,
• not cancel without valid reason.

In the event of a breach:
• the commission is refunded,
• the platform may apply penalties.

sections.heading: 8. Passenger obligations
sections.body:
Passengers agree to:
• pay the booking commission,
• comply with the conditions of the trip,
• be present at the agreed time and place.

sections.heading: 9. No right of withdrawal
sections.body: Given the nature of the service (a booking tied to a specific date), passengers do not have a right of withdrawal once the booking is confirmed.

sections.heading: 10.1 Kouby's liability
sections.body:
Kouby is responsible only for:
• connecting users,
• the proper functioning of the booking platform.

Kouby cannot be held liable for:
• the transportation itself,
• incidents occurring during the trip,
• the behaviour of users.

sections.heading: 10.2 Driver's liability
sections.body:
Drivers are solely responsible for:
• carrying out the trip,
• passenger safety,
• compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

sections.heading: 11. Disputes
sections.body:
In the event of a dispute:
• an amicable resolution will be attempted first,
• failing that, the competent courts of Canada and the relevant province will have jurisdiction.

sections.heading: 12. Regulatory compliance
sections.body:
The services offered comply with applicable Canadian law, notably:
• rules relating to carpooling,
• consumer protection obligations,
• provincial regulations.

sections.heading: 13. Changes to these Terms of Sale
sections.body: Kouby reserves the right to modify these Terms of Sale at any time. Users will be informed of any updates.

sections.heading: 14. Final clause
sections.body: The commission charged by Kouby corresponds solely to a digital intermediation service. The transport service is provided independently by the driver, under their sole responsibility.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: This Agreement governs the conditions under which a driver uses the Kouby platform to offer ridesharing services.

sections.heading: 2. Driver Status
sections.body: The driver acts as an independent individual. No employment or subordination relationship exists between Kouby and the driver.

sections.heading: 3. Eligibility Requirements
sections.body:
The driver must:
• hold a valid Canadian driver's license,
• have valid auto insurance,
• operate a compliant and roadworthy vehicle,
• be at least 18 years old.

sections.heading: 4. Driver Responsibility
sections.body:
The driver is solely responsible for:
• legal compliance,
• passenger safety,
• compliance with applicable laws.

Kouby disclaims all liability for non-compliance.

sections.heading: 5. Required Information
sections.body:
The driver must provide accurate information:
• identity,
• license,
• vehicle details,
• insurance,
• trip details.

False information is strictly prohibited.

sections.heading: 6. Trip Listings
sections.body:
The driver agrees to:
• publish accurate listings,
• respect trip conditions,
• transport passengers as agreed.

sections.heading: 7. Cancellation
sections.body:
The driver may not cancel without valid reason.

In case of cancellation:
• must offer an alternative,
• or reimburse the reservation fee.

sections.heading: 8. Prohibited Conduct
sections.body:
It is prohibited to:
• publish false listings,
• replace passengers without consent,
• fail to meet commitments.

Sanctions may include suspension, termination, and damages.

sections.heading: 9. Payments and Fees
sections.body: The driver pays no fees to Kouby.

sections.heading: 10. Insurance
sections.body:
The driver must maintain insurance covering:
• passengers,
• property and bodily damage.

sections.heading: 11. Limitation of Liability
sections.body:
Kouby is not liable for:
• accidents,
• disputes between users,
• losses or damages.

sections.heading: 12. Personal Data
sections.body: Data is processed in accordance with the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 13. Suspension
sections.body: Kouby may suspend or terminate accounts for violations.

sections.heading: 14. Governing Law
sections.body: This Agreement is governed by the laws of Canada and the applicable province.

sections.heading: 15. Acceptance
sections.body: The driver acknowledges having read and accepted this Agreement.

sections.heading: 16. Final clause
sections.body: The driver acts as an independent user. Kouby does not provide transportation services.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.disclaimer: Some details still need to be filled in before publishing (last-updated date, data protection officer contact information) — see the "[to be completed]" notes below.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.body:
Kouby ("Kouby," "we") places the utmost importance on protecting its users' personal information.

This privacy policy describes the types of data we collect, how we use and retain it, and users' rights, in accordance with Canadian law — notably the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA).

sections.heading: 2. Definition of personal information
sections.body:
"Personal information" refers to any information that can directly or indirectly identify an individual, including:
• First and last name
• Address
• Phone number
• Email address
• Location data
• Vehicle information (for drivers)
• Payment information

sections.heading: 3.1 Information provided by the user
sections.body:
When registering or using the platform, we collect:
• Identity (first and last name)
• Contact details (email, phone number)
• Profile information
• Driver-related documents (licence, vehicle, insurance)
• Trip-related information (departure, destination, schedule)

sections.heading: 3.2 Automatically collected data
sections.body:
We also collect:
• IP address
• Device and browser type
• Browsing data
• Platform usage history

sections.heading: 3.3 Payment data
sections.body: Payments are processed through secure third-party providers. Kouby does not store full banking details.

sections.heading: 4. Purpose of collection
sections.body:
Data is collected to:
• Create and manage user accounts
• Facilitate connections between drivers and passengers
• Manage bookings and payments
• Improve our services and the user experience
• Keep the platform secure
• Comply with legal and regulatory obligations

sections.heading: 5. Consent
sections.body:
By using the platform, users consent to the collection, use, and disclosure of their data in accordance with this policy.

Consent may be withdrawn at any time, subject to legal obligations.

sections.heading: 6. Data sharing
sections.body:
Data may be shared:
• Between users (e.g. driver and passenger)
• With technical service providers (hosting, payments)
• With competent authorities where legally required

Kouby never sells personal data.

sections.heading: 7. Data retention
sections.body:
Data is retained:
• for as long as necessary to provide the service,
• and in accordance with Canadian legal obligations.

sections.heading: 8. Data security
sections.body:
Kouby implements appropriate security measures:
• Data encryption
• Restricted access
• Intrusion protection systems

sections.heading: 9. User rights
sections.body:
Under PIPEDA, users have the following rights:
• Access to their data
• Correction of inaccurate data
• Deletion (within legal limits)
• Withdrawal of consent

Requests can be sent via our Contact page, or to: [email to be completed].

sections.heading: 10. International data transfers
sections.body: Data may be hosted or processed outside Canada. In such cases, Kouby ensures an adequate level of protection, consistent with PIPEDA's requirements.

sections.heading: 11. Cookies and similar technologies
sections.body:
The platform uses cookies to:
• Improve the user experience
• Analyze site usage

Users can manage their cookie preferences directly through their browser.

sections.heading: 12. Protection of minors
sections.body: The platform is not intended for individuals under 18. We do not knowingly collect data from minors.

sections.heading: 13. Data protection officer
sections.body:
For any question or request regarding this policy, our data protection officer can be reached at:
📧 [email to be completed]
📍 [address to be completed]

sections.heading: 14. Changes to this policy
sections.body: Kouby reserves the right to modify this policy at any time. Users will be notified of any material update.

sections.heading: 15. Final clause
sections.body:
Kouby is committed to complying with PIPEDA's ten fair information principles, as well as the requirements of Quebec's Law 25 on the protection of personal information:
• Accountability
• Identifying purposes
• Consent
• Limiting collection
• Limiting use, disclosure, and retention
• Accuracy
• Safeguards
• Openness
• Individual access
• Challenging compliance

Responsibility.lastUpdated: How Kouby and its users share responsibility.

sections.heading: Kouby's role
sections.body: Kouby is a technical intermediary. We connect drivers and passengers, take bookings, and collect the platform commission. We are not a carrier and we do not operate the trip.

sections.heading: Drivers
sections.body: The driver is solely responsible for the trip: a valid licence, insurance, a roadworthy vehicle, and compliance with the highway safety code of the province of travel.

sections.heading: Passengers
sections.body: Passengers are responsible for arriving on time, paying according to the chosen method, and following the conditions of the listing.

sections.heading: Related documents
sections.body: See also the terms of use, the terms of sale, and the driver agreement.

BecomeDriver.title: How to become a driver
BecomeDriver.lastUpdated: Publish a trip on Kouby in a few steps.

sections.heading: 1. Create an account
sections.body: Sign up with your email, then complete your profile. Drivers must also send identity and vehicle documents from My documents so we can verify them.

sections.heading: 2. Publish a trip
sections.body: From Publish a trip, enter the route, date, seats, price per seat, and which payment methods you accept (card, Interac, cash).

sections.heading: 3. Accept bookings
sections.body: When a passenger requests a seat, accept or reject from My trips. Accepting issues the Kouby invoice and asks the passenger to pay.

sections.heading: 4. After the trip
sections.body: If the passenger paid by card, Kouby holds the fare and pays it out after departure. Interac and cash fares are settled directly with you; Kouby only keeps the 5 CAD commission.

BecomePassenger.title: How to become a passenger
BecomePassenger.lastUpdated: Book a seat on Kouby in a few steps.

sections.heading: 1. Create an account
sections.body: Sign up with your email, then search for a trip by city and date.

sections.heading: 2. Book a seat
sections.body: Choose how you will pay the driver: card (fare + 5 CAD commission to Kouby), Interac, or cash (5 CAD commission to Kouby, fare paid to the driver).

sections.heading: 3. Pay after acceptance
sections.body: When the driver accepts, you receive an invoice. Pay it to confirm your seat. Card payments include the fare; Interac and cash pay only the commission.

sections.heading: 4. Travel
sections.body: Meet at the pickup point on time. After the trip you can rate the driver from My bookings.

sections.heading: Book early
sections.body: Popular routes fill up. Send your request with the right number of seats and a payment method the driver already accepts.

sections.heading: Pay on time
sections.body: A booking stays awaiting payment until the invoice is paid. Unpaid requests expire and the seats go back to other passengers.

sections.heading: Stay reachable
sections.body: Use the booking messages to confirm the meeting point. Arrive a few minutes early and keep a charged phone.

sections.heading: If plans change
sections.body: Cancel from My bookings as soon as you know. After confirmation, only the fare is refunded on a card booking; the commission is kept unless the driver cancels.

DriverTips.title: Tips for drivers
DriverTips.lastUpdated: Publish trips that fill and run smoothly.

sections.heading: Be accurate
sections.body: List the real pickup and drop-off, the true departure time, and only the seats you can actually offer.

sections.heading: Offer the right payment methods
sections.body: Card lets Kouby collect the fare and pay you after the trip. Interac and cash mean passengers settle the fare with you directly and only pay the 5 CAD commission on the platform.

sections.heading: Answer quickly
sections.body: Pending requests expire. Accept or reject soon so passengers are not left waiting, and keep documents up to date in My documents.

sections.heading: If you must cancel
sections.body: Cancel from My trips as early as you can. Kouby refunds the passenger according to the terms of sale.
